from pathlib import Path
import json,os,subprocess
r=Path('/home/claude/code/EKA2L1');s=Path('/home/claude/.scratch/eka-benchmark');a=s/'branch-veneer-candidate'
e=dict(os.environ,PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH='/usr/bin/chromium',EKA2L1_WASM_BUILD_DIR=str(a),EKA2L1_AOT_IR_MODE='7',EKA2L1_AOT_EAGER_REGIONS='0',EKA2L1_TLB_HASH='1',EKA2L1_SHARED_AUDIO='1',EKA2L1_BENCHMARK_AOT='5',EKA2L1_AOT_VERIFY='1024',EKA2L1_CODE_COMPARE='2',EKA2L1_CODE_LOOKUP='0',EKA2L1_PREDICATED_LEAVES='1',EKA2L1_LEAF_FEATURES='0',EKA2L1_EXIT_CENSUS='0')
for key in ['LD_LIBRARY_PATH','EKA2L1_CODE_WRITE_PROTECT','EKA2L1_GUEST_PROFILE','EKA2L1_AOT_DIAGNOSTICS']:e.pop(key,None)
def run(args,name,cwd=r,env=e):
 with(s/name).open('w')as log:subprocess.run(args,cwd=cwd,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True,timeout=3600)
 print(name+' PASS',flush=True)
for sites in [4,16]:
 limits=f'512,16,{sites},512';prefix=f'conditional-sites-{sites}'
 run(['python3','src/tests/benchmark/run_cpu_fault_matrix.py',str(a),str(s/(prefix+'-fault')),'--ir-policy','7','--code-compare','2','--tlb-hash','1','--execution-limits',limits,'--predicated-leaves','1','--exit-census','0','--leaf-features','0'],prefix+'-fault.log')
 f=json.loads((s/(prefix+'-fault/summary.json')).read_text());assert f['completed_cases']==40640 and f['leaf_features']==0 and all(x['all_fields_match']==x['cases'] for x in f['results'])
 for scene,frames,route,start,ref,pcm in [('standard',1600,'snakes.input',21000000,'merge-20260930-native',4656051),('long',360,'snakes-length-long.input',42000000,'merge-20260930-long-native',2832756)]:
  out=s/(prefix+'-'+scene)
  run(['node','benchmark.ts',str(s/'assets'),str(out),str(frames),str(r/'src/tests/benchmark'/route),str(start)],prefix+'-'+scene+'.log',r/'src/tests/wasm',dict(e,EKA2L1_EXECUTION_LIMITS=limits))
  run(['python3','src/tests/benchmark/compare.py',str(s/ref/'run-0/frames'),str(out)],prefix+'-'+scene+'-compare.json')
  c=json.loads((s/(prefix+'-'+scene+'-compare.json')).read_text());assert c['match'] and c['frames']==frames and c['audio']['sample_frames']==pcm
  q=json.loads((out/'report.json').read_text());assert q['ir_mode']==7 and q['leaf_features']==0 and q['predicated_leaves']==1 and q['execution_limits']==[512,16,sites,512] and q['verify_aot']==1024 and not q['exit_census']
  assert q['wasm_sha256']==json.loads((a/'source.json').read_text())['files']['eka2l1.wasm']
print('Conditional site bounds 4 and 16 accepted; existing site 8 controls retained',flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import os,subprocess,json,sys
r=Path('/home/claude/code/EKA2L1');s=Path('/home/claude/.scratch/eka-benchmark');a=s/'branch-veneer-candidate';baseline=s/'predicated-leaf-candidate'
scene,batch=sys.argv[1:];assert scene in ('long','standard') and batch in ('a','b')
start,end,route=(42000000,60000000,'snakes-length-long.input')if scene=='long'else(60000000,78000000,'snakes.input')
order={'a':['control8','sites4','sites16','baseline'],'b':['sites16','baseline','control8','sites4']}[batch]
args=['python3','src/tests/benchmark/serial_variants.py',str(s/'assets'),str(s/f'conditional-site-timing-{scene}-{batch}')]+[f'{n}={baseline if n=="baseline" else a}'for n in order]
for name in order:
 sites={'sites4':4,'sites16':16}.get(name,8)
 for option,value in [('ir-mode','7'),('eager-regions','0'),('tlb-hash','1'),('code-compare','2'),('code-lookup','0'),('execution-limits',f'512,16,{sites},512'),('predicated-leaves','1'),('leaf-features','0'),('input',str(r/'src/tests/benchmark'/route))]:args.extend(['--'+option,f'{name}={value}'])
args+=['--start-us',str(start),'--end-us',str(end)]
subprocess.run(args,cwd=r,env=dict(os.environ,EKA2L1_SHARED_AUDIO='1'),check=True)
rows=json.loads((s/f'conditional-site-timing-{scene}-{batch}/measurements.json').read_text());assert len(rows)==8
assert len({tuple(x['measurement'][k]for k in ['first_instructions','last_instructions','presentations'])for x in rows})==1
print(scene,batch,'identical guest work verified',flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import json,time,subprocess
s=Path('/home/claude/.scratch/eka-benchmark');r=Path('/home/claude/code/EKA2L1');state=s/'conditional-site-finish-state.json'
def phase(name,**kw):
 state.write_text(json.dumps(dict(phase=name,utc=time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ',time.gmtime()),**kw),indent=2)+'\n');print(name,kw,flush=True)
def run(script,logname,gpu=False):
 args=['bash','-lc',f'source {s}/write-protection-gpu.env\npython3 {s}/{script}']if gpu else['python3',str(s/script)]
 with(s/logname).open('w')as log:subprocess.run(args,cwd=r,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
def commit(message):
 subprocess.run(['git','add','src/tests/benchmark/CONDITIONAL_SITE_LIMITS_RESULTS.md','src/tests/benchmark/CONDITIONAL_SITE_LIMITS_EVIDENCE.json'],cwd=r,check=True)
 subprocess.run(['git','commit','-m',message],cwd=r,check=True)
try:
 phase('waiting_for_veneer_analysis')
 while not(s/'branch-veneer-analysis-complete.json').exists():time.sleep(5)
 assert json.loads((s/'branch-veneer-module-state.json').read_text())['phase']=='modules_complete'
 phase('correctness')
 run('conditional_site_acceptance.py','conditional-site-acceptance.log')
 run('record_conditional_site_acceptance.py','conditional-site-acceptance-record.log')
 commit('Verify changed conditional-leaf site limits against native faults and replay')
 phase('serial_timing')
 run('guarded_conditional_site_timings.py','conditional-site-timing-driver.log')
 run('record_conditional_site_timings.py','conditional-site-timing-record.log')
 commit('Retain reordered serial conditional-leaf site-limit measurements')
 phase('census')
 run('run_conditional_site_census.py','conditional-site-census-driver.log',gpu=True)
 phase('census_complete_pending_record')
except Exception as error:phase('failure',error=str(error));raise

from pathlib import Path
import os,json,subprocess
r=Path('/home/claude/code/EKA2L1');s=Path('/home/claude/.scratch/eka-benchmark');a=s/'branch-veneer-candidate'
checklog=s/'conditional-site-diagnostic-acceptance.log'
if not checklog.exists() or 'Instrumented conditional site bounds 4 and 16 accepted' not in checklog.read_text():
 with checklog.open('w')as log:subprocess.run(['python3',str(s/'conditional_site_diagnostic_acceptance.py')],cwd=r,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
e=dict(os.environ,EKA2L1_WASM_BUILD_DIR=str(a),EKA2L1_AOT_IR_MODE='7',EKA2L1_AOT_EAGER_REGIONS='0',EKA2L1_TLB_HASH='1',EKA2L1_SHARED_AUDIO='1',EKA2L1_BENCHMARK_AOT='5',EKA2L1_AOT_VERIFY='0',EKA2L1_CODE_COMPARE='2',EKA2L1_CODE_LOOKUP='0',EKA2L1_EXIT_CENSUS='1',EKA2L1_GUEST_PROFILE='1021',EKA2L1_PROFILE_DETAIL='1',EKA2L1_GPU='hardware',EKA2L1_EXECUTION_LIMITS='512,16,8,512')
e.pop('EKA2L1_CODE_WRITE_PROTECT',None)
for scene,start,end,route in [('long',42000000,60000000,'snakes-length-long.input'),('standard',60000000,78000000,'snakes.input')]:
 for mode,sites,leaf in [('sites4',4,16),('sites16',16,16)]:
  out=s/f'conditional-site-census-{scene}-{mode}'
  env=dict(e,EKA2L1_PREDICATED_LEAVES='1',EKA2L1_LEAF_FEATURES='0',EKA2L1_EXECUTION_LIMITS=f'512,{leaf},{sites},512',EKA2L1_PROFILE_START_US=str(start),EKA2L1_PROFILE_INPUT=str(r/'src/tests/benchmark'/route))
  with out.with_suffix('.log').open('w')as log:
   subprocess.run(['node','profile.ts',str(s/'assets'),str(out),'2','0',str(end)],cwd=r/'src/tests/wasm',env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True,timeout=2400)
  report=json.loads((out/'report.json').read_text());assert report['predicated_leaves']==1 and report['leaf_features']==0 and report['exit_census'] and report['ir_mode']==7 and report['execution_limits']==[512,leaf,sites,512]
  assert report['tlb_hash']==1 and report['code_compare']==2 and report['code_lookup']==0 and report['eager_regions']==0 and report['shared_audio']
  assert report['wasm_sha256']==json.loads((s/'branch-veneer-candidate/source.json').read_text())['files']['eka2l1.wasm']
  guest=json.loads((out/'guest-profile.json').read_text());b=guest['boundaries']
  assert bool(b['lifetime_compile_events'].get('branch_veneer_inlined',0))==False;assert sum(b['region_exits'].values())==guest['compiled_blocks']
  assert sum(b['callee_restrictions'].values())==b['call_constraints'].get('callee_unsupported',0)
  assert sum(x['calls']for x in b['rejected_call_sites'])+b['dropped_rejected_calls']==b['call_constraints'].get('callee_unsupported',0)
  assert sum(b['code_guard_outcomes'].values())==sum(b['region_exits'].get(k,0)for k in ['code_write_guard','helper_and_code_write'])
  assert sum(b['entry_proof_fallback_causes'].values())==b['entry_proof_fallbacks']<=b['entry_proof_attempts']<=b['calls']
  assert sum(b['entry_proof_overlap_outcomes'].values())+b['entry_proof_overlap_dropped']<=b['entry_write_span_checks']
  assert not b['entry_proof_overlap_dropped']
  expected=(6445351805,9476989025,380)if scene=='long'else(8980877653,11957513019,381)
  assert tuple(report['measurement'][k]for k in ['first_instructions','last_instructions','presentations'])==expected
  print(scene,mode,'calls',guest['compiled_blocks'],'exits',b['region_exits'],'footprint',report.get('runtime_footprint'),flush=True)
